## Checklist

- [ ] My commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, …)
- [ ] The pre-commit guard passed (or I confirmed `--no-verify` was safe for an example/doc path)
- [ ] No personal paths, IPs, credentials, or data files (`.todos.json`, `.epics.json`, …) leaked
- [ ] No new dependencies added, or I justified why they're needed
- [ ] No cloud calls, telemetry, or network egress introduced (QuestLog is local-first)
- [ ] I tested the change manually — the menu bar popup, kanban, and plan board still work
